Select: compound_chembl_id, compound_name, max_phase, type, canonical_smiles
Source: molecule_dictionary, compound_records, compound_structures, docs
Join: molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_records.molregno; compound_records.doc_id = docs.doc_id; compound_records.molregno = compound_structures.molregno
Filter: docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1130277'
Sort: compound_chembl_id ASC
